command:
set -eu
export PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD"
H=postgres.postgres.svc.cluster.local
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)
for DB in $(psql -h "$H" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -At \
    -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate"); do
  echo "dumping $DB"
  pg_dump -h "$H" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -Fc "$DB" \
    > "/backups/${DB}-${STAMP}.dump.tmp"
  mv "/backups/${DB}-${STAMP}.dump.tmp" "/backups/${DB}-${STAMP}.dump"
done
find /backups -name '*.dump' -mtime +14 -delete
find /backups -name '*.dump.tmp' -mmin +120 -delete
echo "backup complete:"; ls -la /backups | tail -20
containers.name: backup
